title: NAVAIR high energy electromagnetic field generator experiment

tellings.quote: We worked on a high energy electromagnetic field generated experiment uh at Navier. Uh however we weren't able to obtain a charge an electrical charge of more than 10 the minus 8 kms. We need at least one to show that the pis effect is correct.

plain: A Navy experiment with a high-energy electromagnetic field generator fell far short of what it needed, says Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents on unusual craft designs and who worked on it himself. He tells Michels the test ran at NAVAIR, the Navy's aircraft research command, and that they could not get an electrical charge above ten to the minus eight of the unit, when they needed at least one "to show that the Pais effect is correct," the effect named after him that his designs rely on. Had it worked, it would have backed his idea that such fields could power new kinds of flight.
